decisions.reason: The source specifies referral-validation popup behavior, not a revision to the FAQ; the existing FAQ statement about mints without a referral code remains valid.
This Requirement already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE containing both popup messages, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
The valid-code popup restates the existing $5 commission and one $500 Small Block ticket for a coded referral without changing the reward.
The source does not change the $15 mint allocation, the $5 referral commission, or the active prize-pool funding split.
Mentioning a $500 prize-draw ticket does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, eligible population, or draw trigger.
The source changes referral validation and popup wording but does not change which counters, badges, or referral identifiers appear in NFT metadata.
The source does not alter prize-pool funding amounts, funding sale types, duration, or the active pool.
Randomly assigning a no-code or invalid-code referral reward to an existing NFT holder is distinct from selecting a Small Block prize winner and does not change the draw-selection rules.
The source changes which referral inputs trigger a random ticket award, not ticket counters, eligibility windows, expiration, or post-draw reset behavior.
The requirement already states that only already minted NFTs are valid referral codes; the source reiterates that rule without changing it.
The source does not change the NFT mint number as the referral-code basis, its persistence, or any display and email locations.
The source defines validation feedback and reward routing but does not change how commissions or tickets are displayed in the dashboard.
